headline: Approved City Year contract for Slater Middle School and a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement; continued virtual instruction day plans.
summary: Members heard updates on the Slater Middle School redesign, Right to Read, the graduation audit, the new Pawtucket High School, and Tolman's accreditation. They approved minutes, a parking agreement with Blackstone Valley Community Health Care, a City Year contract, and a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement. They continued the virtual instruction day plans and the template contracts.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 15, 2026 meeting unanimously.
Continued the template contracts item to the next meeting.
Approved a parking agreement (MOA) with Blackstone Valley Community Health Care unanimously.
Continued the approval of the virtual instruction day plans to the next meeting so the union can discuss them on 10/7.
Approved the City Year contract to support the Slater Middle School redesign unanimously.
Approved a motion to draft an MOA with the city to establish a revolving fund for housing aid reimbursement, unanimously.
